description: Page-specific keyword targets for the four public Steem Games pages. Targets are based on each page's actual subject and current source content; they are not search-volume or ranking data.

index.html.intent: Main directory and discovery page for games built on the Steem blockchain.

about.html.intent: Explains the purpose, mission, community participation and ownership of the Steem Games directory.

faq.html.intent: Answers practical questions about the directory, game rankings, D2E rewards, voting and account access. The FAQ-specific phrase is a supporting target to distinguish this page's help intent from the homepage.
supporting: how to vote on Steem Games

game-info.html.intent: Game-specific detail page template for game information, developer details, dedicated tags, genres, statistics and external play links. Game content and headings are populated dynamically from the API.

usage.primaryKeyword: Use one page-specific primary phrase. Avoid assigning the same broad commercial phrase to multiple pages unless the page intent genuinely overlaps.
usage.supportingKeywords: Supporting phrases describe secondary subtopics and search intents. They are contextual guidance only; the current seven keyword checks evaluate the primary phrase, not every supporting phrase independently.
usage.url: URL checks run only when urlKeywords are explicitly configured. Keep this empty where the current URL is a generic filename or a dynamic query-string route.
usage.density: Estimated exact-phrase density is a diagnostic only. A density above 3% is not a Google ranking threshold and should trigger editorial review, not automatic keyword stuffing.
usage.limitations: This strategy is based on current public source content, not search-volume, competition, ranking or indexing data. game-info.html loads game-specific content and its H1 dynamically; source-only checks cannot fully evaluate the rendered page.
